description: This file defines the ContentInfoActivity class for an Android application. It constructs a full-screen, pixel-precise layout to display content details such as title and synopsis on a TV interface, using native Android views for layout and focus management. It handles focus trapping, key navigation, and user interactions with primary and secondary action buttons.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed content information in a pixel-perfect layout suitable for TV, handling focus navigation and user interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity layout, sets up focus trapping views, content display views, and action buttons.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles hardware key events such as back button presses to finish the activity.

methods.name: pillButtonView
methods.description: Creates a focusable, styled button that mimics a pill shape with focus and click handling.

methods.name: spacer
methods.description: Creates a non-focusable view used as spacing between buttons.

methods.name: dp
methods.description: Converts density-independent pixels to actual pixel values based on device density.
